brief:
An Israeli drone strike on Gaza City's Tal al-Hawa neighbourhood has killed a second person, according to the Wafa news agency. The death toll from the earlier strike has now risen to two, marking an escalation in the casualty count from the single incident in the densely populated residential area.

A separate Israeli drone strike also struck an area west of Khan Yunis, though immediate details about casualties or the extent of damage from that strike were not yet available. The two strikes underscored the ongoing military operations across different sectors of the Gaza Strip.

title: Israeli drone strike kills second Palestinian in Gaza City
